Sheet sensitivity row verbatim: "Sensitivity@1W,1m" 4 ohm 95.1 dB, 8 ohm 94.2 dB, 16 ohm 94.7 dB. The sheet does not state the T/S measurement method, drive level or ambient conditions, nor the voltage behind "1W" (conventionally 2.83 V for 8 ohm, 2.0 V for 4 ohm, 4.0 V for 16 ohm). Uncertainty fields describe transcription only (values are the manufacturer's own numbers, given to 8+ significant figures); the measurement's own uncertainty is unstated. Curve key nominal= is the nominal impedance in ohm of the version measured.
